Name: Lance's Babies
Author: StardewStardude
Description:
A sprite recolour for Lance's babies, as it bugs me that they're as Ginger as Leah, when Lance's hair is a crimson-pinkish colour.

It goes into the Babies folder for Lance in Unique Children, or can be put into the folder Baby for Babies take after Spouse v2.

Also works with Customizable Babies and Toddlers, or Unique Children if you don't like the green baby blanket or romper, which is in the second screenshot, including Kedi's Kids furniture, as well as Polyamory Sweet which denotes the baby as Lance's after the Baby's name.

(Do not use both Unique Children and Customizable Babies and Toddlers with the baby, because they seem to override each other, the baby's hair will keep changing)

This shouldn't really need a ton of updates unless they add different baby sprites.

Downloads.Description: The main file to go inside the mods requires a file for Lance's children. DOES NOT contain a JSON as it doesn't need one, going into mods that already have them.
